entries.officialDescription: Don't think about what this skill does, just use it because it comes off cooldown really fast. Deals stacking bonus damage and increases your Dodge by 10% if the last skill used was this one, up to 15 times. Using another skill removes the Dodge and damage bonus. Can't crit.
entries.evidence: Button Mash Rank Needed: 1 Mana Cost: 10 Mana Cooldown: 1.5 Seconds Type: Physical Description: Don't think about what this skill does, just use it because it comes off cooldown really fast. Deals stacking bonus damage and increases your Dodge by 10% if the last skill used was this one, up to 15 times. Using another skill removes the Dodge and damage bonus. Can't crit. If you're Caffeinated, this skill can crit and it builds your Combo count, increasing your Crit Damage by 20% for 3 seconds, stacks to 15.

entries.officialDescription: This is a completely average hit which does perfectly normal damage…
entries.evidence: Reasonable Strike Rank Needed: 2 Mana Cost: 0 Mana Cooldown: 4 Seconds Type: Physical Description: This is a completely average hit which does perfectly normal damage… What do you mean this is just another Auto Attack? You want this skill to actually do something? Ok fine, if you want a way for this class to recover mana that bad, then this skill now FULLY recovers your mana, ARE YOU HAPPY?

entries.officialDescription: Eat a handful of chips, healing you and applying Fueled, increasing your Hit Chance and Haste Chance by 20% for 20 seconds.
entries.evidence: Gamer Fuel Rank Needed: 3 Mana Cost: 0 Mana Cooldown: 10 Seconds Type: Physical Description: Eat a handful of chips, healing you and applying Fueled, increasing your Hit Chance and Haste Chance by 20% for 20 seconds. If you have 3 stacks of Gamer Rage, you also chug an Energy Drink. Applies Caffeinated, causing all skills to crit, reducing mana costs by 100%, healing you over time, and increasing your Haste, Hit Chance, and Dodge by 100% for 15 seconds. Drinking your Energy Drink quells your rage.
